column1: # Note: samples live entirely in PSRAM (40 s × 44.1 kHz × 2 B = ~3.4 MB).
# Only sketches are persisted to flash.
# 16 MB total flash on the N16R8; sketches partition is 8 MB (= 0x800000)
# so we can hold ~5 typical sketches at 44.1 kHz. See docs/DESIGN.md S11.8.
# Note: the per-sketch 16 patterns (g_patterns[16]) are kept named
# "pattern" deliberately to match the PO-33's terminology; only the
# sketch unit (PO-33's "song") is named "sketch" here. See S11.
